title: acer amplum var. tietaiense
intro: Acer amplum var. tietaiense, commonly known as Taiwanese maple, is a plant species within the Aceraceae family. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer amplum var. tietaiense include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
